ध्वजवती

DHVAJAVATĪ . The daughter of the hermit Harimedha, who lived in the sky, according to the order of the Sun. (M.B. Udyoga Parva, Chapter 110, Stanza 13).

ध्वजिनी

DHVAJINĪ . A country in ancient india. (M.B. bhīṣma Parva, Chapter 83).

ध्वनि

DHVANI . The son of āpa who is one of the eight Vasus. āpa had four sons called vaitaṇḍa, śrama, śānta and dhvani. (viṣṇu purāṇa, Āṁśa 1, Chapter 15).

ध्वन्य

DHVANYA . A king. He was the son of lakṣmaṇa. (See ṛgveda Index).

ध्वसन्ति

DHVASANTI . A hermit of the period of the ṛgveda. aśvinīdevas rescued the hermits turvīti, dabhīti, dhvasanti and puruṣanti from danger. ṛgveda, Maṇḍala 1, Anuvāka 16, Sūkta 112).
